name: Whirling Ovation

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.description:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.description:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Anticipation
perks.description: The charge speed of this weapon's next shot slowly increases over time. Anticipation builds more quickly as you deal more damage with other weapons.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: Forget the pain, forget the practice, forget the blisters under your dancing shoes. Your audience is waiting.

catalyst.name: Whirling Ovation Catalyst
catalyst.description: Fully charged shots over-penetrate weaker combatants and cause a delayed Solar detonation with a brief scorching field.
